summary: Transocean Ltd. filed an 8-K disclosing its agreement with Equinor for semisubmersible rigs valued at over $1 billion in contract backlog across seven rig years, with a base day rate of $399,000 increasing above $400,000 at commencement. Additionally, Transocean is acquiring Valaris Limited in a stock-for-stock business combination, exchanging 15.235 shares per Valaris share. Closing is conditional on CFIUS clearance and HSR Act waiting period expiration; a June 29, 2026 CFIUS notice extended the review to 45 days. Watch for regulatory approvals and potential risk-arb spread on the Valaris combination.
